summary.text: Doug Dern is an attorney and the chair of the Natural Law Party of Michigan, which has nominated him for attorney general. He appears on the Bureau of Elections' general-election candidate listing and in Votebeat's ballot guide.

paragraphs.text: Dern earned an undergraduate degree from Oklahoma University in 1999 and a J.D. from Thomas Cooley Law School in 2002, and has worked as an attorney.
